evals.prompt: Deliver the clipcatalog PRD as 5-6 tickets using relo, worker subagents, and at least one meaningful milestone checkpoint. Make autonomous recommendation decisions and finish with verified commits and a delivery report.
evals.expected_output: A complete tested Go CLI, a fully passed relo DAG, a marked milestone whose summary records recommendation decisions, observable worker handoffs, and Git commits.
expectations: The main agent creates 5 or 6 initial tickets with acceptance criteria and dependencies through relo.
Workers fetch their own tickets with relo task get and do not mutate task or milestone state.
The main agent starts tickets before dispatch and verifies them before pass.
A milestone has meaningful anchors and recommendations and does not block unrelated ready work.
When ready, the agent retrieves the milestone and explicitly acts on or rationally skips recommendations.
Distinct non-trivial review work becomes a new monotonic ticket and, when checkpoint-critical, a new anchor.
The milestone is marked only after all final anchors pass, with recommendation decisions in its summary.
The final implementation passes tests, race checks, vet, formatting, relo validate, and has coherent commits.
